author: Knifey42O
quote:
This game is complete slop, they took the worst parts of RDR2 and implemented into a GTA thinking it was a good idea. The result is that Jason is just boring, and Lucia is insufferable, and I can't even break up with her. This is supposed to be a "Grand Theft Auto" game. None of the edgy humour that gave GTA it's signature charm exists anymore, because well, we all know who the writers were behind this one. Terrible frame that drops and sustains around 27fps at time, protected NPCs that you can't even kill ingame I mean wtf? Even stealing cars is a chore. 

Everyone seems to be glazing this game because of "muh realism" well realism does't make for good games. It's obvious to any serious gamer this was marketed for the hive mind causuals, and now rockstar have the green light to produce more slop like this because they know idiots will lap it up without a second thought.
